g.title: Figure title
g.text: Stage S1 -- numeric baseline, vision off
The vision-free reference run. Every later stage is reported as a delta against this one. Shapes for uk_pv; B = batch.

g.title: Input tensors
g.text: the 12 steps ahead are known, not predicted

g.title: Per-modality front ends
g.text: out: patched context and per-patch mask
plus (loc, scale), kept for the inverse
each covariate channel becomes its own token
row on the batch axis, with mask = 1

g.title: Projection into the 512-d token space
g.text: input_patch_embedding (PRETRAINED -- patch 16 matches the checkpoint, so it transfers)
shared by the target row and all 14 covariate rows; the horizon patch uses embed_future
input_patch_size = output_patch_size = 16, so no separate future_patch_embedding is built

g.title: MultimodalEmbedding
g.text: MultimodalEmbedding (additive tags, FROM SCRATCH) + RoPE position ids
segment {context, horizon} + token-type {target, covariate} + entity id. Modality tag is always num = 0.

g.title: No fusion in this stage
g.text: vision is off: no V-JEPA encoder, no LatentSummarizer, no CrossModalAdapter,
no visual KV field. The token sequence is purely numeric end to end, which is
exactly what makes this arm a clean control for every vision claim.

g.title: Chronos2Encoder
g.text: Chronos2Encoder -- x6 identical blocks (d_model 512, 8 heads, d_kv 64, d_ff 2048)
O(L^2), but L is only 43 patches,
acts on the BATCH axis, not time.
Fuses the target row with the 14
covariate rows across all rows that
share a group_id. No visual row
Block k feeds block k + 1; block 6

g.title: Output head, forecast and loss
g.text: valid horizon steps only; night is masked
reported as NMAE, NRMSE, Skill Score
numeric, horizon and covariate rows, all at 512
last T_hor hidden states, target rows only: [B, 1, 512]
